role: illustrative scoring oracle; never investigator input
oracle_explanation: Two independent faults produce distinct symptoms. Fixing one cannot be credited as resolving the full complaint.

controlled_intervention_spec.design: 2x2 factorial: original/current knowledge crossed with wrong/correct mapper key.
controlled_intervention_spec.limits: Illustrative deterministic expectations; actual intervention execution is absent.

regression_spec.faulted_variant_expectation: Catch each single fault and both together.
regression_spec.healthy_variant_expectation: Pass only when 2.5 and six months are preserved.

scoring_notes: Multi-causal negative for single-root-cause systems; give partial set credit, not full credit for one cause.
provenance: Independently invented for this planning repository. No customer or Almic artifacts.
